request: Make the whole frame structure taller by 0,5cm. The area profile remains the same.

actions.operation: Increase the overall height of the frame structure

parameters.height_direction: Normal to the primary and secondary annular faces, through the part thickness
parameters.profile_constraint: Preserve the existing rounded-rectangular plan area, central aperture, rail widths, corner radii, edge fillets, and outer crown radii

actions.relational_constraint: Keep the existing area profile unchanged while increasing the overall height. Interpret height as the frame's through-thickness dimension because the front and back views define the unchanged rounded-rectangular area profile, while the left, right, top, bottom, and isometric views expose the comparatively thin height direction. Hold the primary annular flange as the mounting datum and displace the opposing secondary side outward by 5 mm. Extend the intervening inner aperture and outer perimeter geometry without scaling or offsetting the in-plane inner and outer boundary loops.
actions.unresolved_reference: The original request does not explicitly identify which broad annular side must remain fixed. Use the visually dominant primary annular face 0000 (FACE 12) as the stationary datum and apply the full 5 mm increase toward the secondary annular face 0001 (FACE 34). If assembly requirements instead demand a centered increase, distribute the same total increase as 2.5 mm on each side while retaining the same profile constraints.
steps: Confirm the model coordinate system and identify the through-thickness axis as the direction normal to the two broad annular lands. The front and back views are treated as views normal to this axis and therefore define the area profile that must remain unchanged.
Use S01 primary annular face 0000 (FACE 12) as the fixed datum. Do not translate, scale, offset, or redraw its outer rounded-rectangle loop or inner aperture loop.

Locate S02 secondary annular face 0001 (FACE 34), which is parallel and opposite to face 0000. Modify the feature or extrusion parameter controlling the separation between these two annular lands so that the overall separation increases by 5 mm.

Where a parametric base sketch and extrusion exist, retain the original closed annular sketch consisting of the outer rounded rectangle and inner rounded rectangle. Increase only the extrusion or thickness extent by 5 mm in the direction from face 0000 toward face 0001.

Where the part is represented as imported or non-parametric B-rep geometry, apply a move-face or offset-face operation to the complete secondary-side termination set. Translate face 0001 and its associated secondary-side radius-2 transition faces outward by 5 mm along the annular-face normal.

Extend the S03 inner aperture interface between the fixed and translated end profiles. Update inner straight walls 0002, 0004, 0006, and 0008 and inner corner patches 0003, 0005, 0007, and 0009 so they span the added 5 mm while retaining the existing aperture dimensions and radius-50 inner corners.

Preserve the S03 radius-2 transition loops at both annular lands. Keep the transition adjacent to S01 fixed; translate or regenerate the transition adjacent to S02 at the new termination. Do not offset the inner wall laterally into the opening, because that would change clearance and mating-part location.

Extend or regenerate the S04 outer perimeter shell over the increased thickness. Maintain the locations of outer narrow straight walls 0010, 0012, 0014, and 0016 and radius-63 corner patches 0011, 0013, 0015, and 0017 in the front-view profile.

Preserve the radius-10 rounded protective crown geometry represented by faces 0018 through 0025. If the crown is attached to the moving secondary side, translate its profile bodily with that side and lengthen the intervening wall region; do not enlarge the crown radius or scale the perimeter.

Maintain all existing tangency and curvature relationships between S01, S02, S03, and S04. Rebuild the radius-2 blends after the height change if direct face extension does not preserve valid tangent intersections.

Do not create new holes, bosses, joints, apertures, or perimeter sections. No existing section is removed; S01 is interacted with as the stationary reference, S02 is displaced, and S03 and S04 are extended or regenerated to connect the two lands.

Regenerate the solid and verify that it remains a single closed-loop watertight body with one continuous central opening. Check for self-intersections or failed blends around all eight inner and outer corner regions.
Measure the final distance between primary face 0000 and secondary face 0001 and confirm that it equals the original overall height plus 5 mm.

Overlay the updated front or back projection with the original model and confirm that the outer rounded-rectangle envelope, inner aperture envelope, straight rail lengths, rail widths, radius-50 inner corners, radius-63 outer corners, radius-10 crown, and radius-2 transition definitions are unchanged.

intention: Increase the frame's through-thickness structural height by 5 mm without changing its front or back projected annular area profile.
Retain the existing central-opening clearance, mating interface, perimeter envelope, corner radii, rail widths, and rounded edge treatment.
Preserve the primary annular flange as the assembly or mounting datum while extending the frame toward the secondary side.
